hero.pillText: YouTube 24/7 — no OBS, no PC running
hero.subtitle: Loopcast loops your videos and audio nonstop — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. No OBS, no machine running, no access to your channel.

noAccess.title: "Do you need access to my YouTube channel?"
noAccess.body: No. We only need the RTMPS URL and stream key from YouTube Studio. Logins, passwords, channel access — they stay with you. Stream keys are encrypted with Fernet+PBKDF2.

howItWorks.subtitle: No OBS, no PC running, no dropped frames when your internet hiccups.

step1.title: Upload
step1.description: Drag videos and audio into your library. Resumable upload — even 100 GB files keep going on flaky connections.

step2.title: Compose
step2.description: Build a playlist or a collection. Video and audio tracks separate. Loop is one click.

step3.title: Drop the key
step3.description: Paste the RTMPS URL and stream key from YouTube Studio. Once — and forever encrypted.

step4.title: Launch
step4.description: Live in 8 seconds. Auto-reconnect, hot-swap the playlist mid-stream, 24/7 monitoring.

demo.subtitle: Drag tracks in the playlist, watch the preview change, check the channel stats. Everything works right here.
demo.monetizeText: The stream runs 24/7. Views accumulate. YouTube monetization — yours.

features.subtitle: You hit start — that's it. No codec settings, no machine slowdowns. Our server holds the stream 24/7.

f1.body: Your video reaches YouTube bit-for-bit, exactly as you uploaded it. No artifacts, no quality loss. And if anything drops — auto-reconnect picks it up in seconds.

f2.title: Earn while you sleep
f2.body: Music channels, lo-fi radio, retro video, lecture loops — your videos run 24/7 and rack up views while you're busy with something else.

f3.title: A stream key nobody sees
f3.body: Fernet + PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, masked in the UI, excluded from logs and metrics.

f4.title: Folders, collections, tags
f4.body: Separate playlists for video and audio. Crossfade. Hot-swap live.

f5.title: Resumable upload
f5.body: Closed the tab at 80%? It picks up from the same byte. Files up to 100 GB.

f6.title: Auto-reconnect
f6.body: YouTube closed the session? Internet hiccupped? New connection in 4 seconds.

items.q: Do I have to give you access to my YouTube channel?
items.a: No. All we need is the RTMPS URL and stream key from YouTube Studio. Channel access, passwords, OAuth — none of that gets touched.
The stream runs on our server — your internet doesn't matter. If the link between us and YouTube drops, auto-reconnect kicks in within 4 seconds.

items.q: Do I need a powerful computer?
items.a: No, none at all. The stream runs on our server. You can close the browser, shut your laptop — the broadcast keeps going.

items.q: Can I change the playlist during a live stream?
items.a: Yes. Hot-swap: add or remove tracks, new ones pick up after the current track without breaking the broadcast.
Solo — 1, Studio — 5, Network — 25. Custom plans for larger volumes.

items.q: Where does my stream key end up?
items.a: Encrypted with Fernet using a key derived through PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, stored only in encrypted form. Never written to logs or metrics.
